ideas.title: Uncovering Social Services Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the social services fraud in Minnesota and the lack of transparency in the recent report.
ideas.angle: Follow the money and investigate the entities involved
questions: What is being hidden in the report?
Who is responsible for the fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale fraud scheme and bring those responsible to justice. By following the money and investigating the entities involved, we can get to the bottom of this story.
